text:
maria: quick sync - designing the "why-it-fired" UX for automatic fallback. goal: make the decision auditable and reduce operator churn.

simon: +1. must capture: signal, window, raw_value, threshold, policy_id, policy_version, decision, chosen_target, route_id.

lee: add evaluated_expression and deploy_hash. replay relies on exact policy code + model tag.

jules: UX: table of firings, compact rows, expandable flyout. flyout shows sparkline, last 5 firings, firing_pattern (spike/sustained/hysteresis), and operator actions.

ops-bot: policy-service:autofallback v2.5 rolled to canary (region-us-west) at 4871240012.

simon: sample ledger row as CSV-friendly string: ts=4871240012,policy=autofallback-v2.5,policy_ver=2026-03-20-1,signal=p95_latency,window=60s,value=1800ms,threshold=1500ms,decision=fallback,target=gptq-8k-quant,route=chat_default,customer=tier-2,pattern=sustained,deploy=sha1:abc123

jules: operator overrides must be immutable with reason + optional ttl. UI should require justification if ttl > 24h.

lee: filters: policy_id, signal, route_id, decision, operator, time-range. timeline sync with deploys/scale events is crucial.

maria: retention: ledger rows 180d, raw metric traces 30d by default. add export button (CSV/JSON) and retention badge on UI.

simon: infra TODOs: estimate rows/day at 10M requests => ~5k firings/day? will simulate. need index on (policy,route,ts).

jules: UI microcopy: explain "pattern" values: spike = single-sample breach; sustained = persisted >= N windows; hysteresis = passed lower-bound check while cooling down.

maria: action items: simon -> draft ledger schema + index plan; lee -> flyout mock + filters; jules -> retention defaults + export format; infra -> cost estimate for 180d ledger + 30d raw. reconvene tomorrow 10am.

ops-bot: note: thread pinned to eng-platform by ops-bot.
